verdict.rationale: Commenting on designs is a fair collaboration axis for a design and website builder like Framer, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack documents no comments, @mentions, or thread resolution. The only collaboration-page item covers branches, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email
